Hi Katie —

Thanks, and appreciate the clear list. We can absolutely support the vendor review and propose the following immediate deliverables: 

1) Attached: "redwood_DPA_redline_for_helix.docx" — our counter-redline to the document you provided. Key notes in summary: we accepted most operational controls but requested edits on (i) indemnity cap language, (ii) clarification on permitted audit scope (see section 7 redline), and (iii) standard mutual indemnities for data breaches attributable to third parties.

2) SOC 2 / pen test: we host a redacted SOC 2 Type II package and a pen-test executive summary in a secure drive. Link below requires a one-time access request (we can add your contracts email):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c4d-redwood-soc2-pen-test

3) Subprocessors: current list is included in the DPA attachment (Appends A). Brief summary: core infra providers (GCP - us-east4), object storage (S3-equivalent), monitoring provider, and one analytics partner (EU data transfers depend on customer configuration). For Helix specifically: if you route EU personal data into our EU region (eu-west1), we can keep processing inside EU and can sign SCCs for any cross-border flows.

4) Audit rights: Redwood typically accepts annual audits or ad-hoc reviews with a minimum 30 days' notice; remote evidence review is our standard approach. For on-site audits we require 60 days' notice and scope confirmation. We've called this out in our redline, section 7.

5) Execution options: we can deliver an execution copy via DocuSign or AdobeSign. Which do you prefer? If DocuSign, we'll send the transaction link; standard turnaround for Redwood Legal to finalize and open for e-sign is ~3 business days from your confirmation.

I attached the redline and included the SOC2/pen-test link above. If helpful, Jonas Weber (copied) can confirm the SCC/transfer workflow. Our target to finalize with you by 2027-04-12 is feasible if we get your review back this week.
